TSB Revision
AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE
23A-72
STEP 18. Check the throttle position sensor.
(1) Disconnect connector B-07 and measure at the sensor 
side.
(2) Measure the resistance between terminal 1 and 4.
Standard value: 3.5 - 6.5 kΩ
(3) Measure resistance between the throttle position sensor 
side connector terminal 1 and 3.
(4) Move the throttle valve from idle position to full-open 
position.
• Resistance should change smoothly in proportion to 
opening angle of the throttle valve.
Q: Is the resistance normal?
YES : Go to Step 19.
NO : Replace the throttle position sensor. Refer to GROUP 
13A <2.4L Engine>, Throttle Body Assembly P.13A-
473 or 13B <3.0L Engine>, Throttle Body Assembly 
P.13B-552.
STEP 19. Check connectors C-54 <2.4L Engine> or C-55 
<3.0L Engine> and C-57 <2.4L Engine> or C-59 <3.0L 
Engine> at PCM for damage.
Q: Are the connectors in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 20.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2.
